analyst_view.overall: Paulo Fonseca takes charge of Sporting for the first time after Rui Borges was sacked on 1 November. Sporting won 1-0 against Shakhtar in midweek under an interim coach. Fonseca says he wants to defend better and press man-to-man. Reports name João Gonçalves as referee, not João Ferreira as the site lists. Moreirense are 9th, have won their last two, and Domingues and Mendonça are doubts.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. A new coach often gives a lift, but Fonseca's first priority is defending better, and Moreirense arrive in form, so the two balance out.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Fonseca says Sporting will play positional attack about 80% of the time, and a pressing, possession side at home against a team that will sit tends to win corners, so we lean slightly higher.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, but they assume a different referee: reports name João Gonçalves, not João Ferreira. Sporting's Maxi Araújo and Luis Suárez are one yellow from a ban before a big run of games, which may make them careful. We lean slightly lower.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.0 shots. Nothing points either way beyond the uncertainty of a new coach.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. No news points either way.
